content: barryvdh/laravel-dompdf v3.1.2 (packagist, wraps dompdf/dompdf v3.1.5). Laravel 12 compatible. Provides Pdf::loadView()/loadHTML() facade, stream/download/response. dompdf v3 supports CSS 2.1 + flexbox partial, @page, headers/footers, remote image blocking by default. No external binary needed (pure PHP). Best Laravel-integrated PDF lib for tabular reports; snappy/wkhtmltopdf needs system binary, Browsershot needs headless Chrome + puppeteer.
